verified.title: Verified Members
verified.body: Profiles may be reviewed, but automated identity and liveness verification are not configured in this app build. Check the verification status shown by the service.

public.title: Public-Only Meetups
public.body: For your safety, choose public places such as cafes, restaurants, malls, or parks. This build does not provide a verified venue catalog or enforce venue type.

live.title: Safety Features
live.body: You can save trusted contacts, but this build does not send them live location or emergency alerts. Keep someone you trust informed about your plans.

community.title: Respectful Community
community.body: CoBuddy operates on mutual respect. Our strict community guidelines ensure every interaction is polite, friendly, and comfortable for all.

modal.title: Safety Guidelines
modal.identity_text: Verification status is provided by the service. Automated identity and liveness verification are not configured in this build.
modal.contacts_text: Trusted contacts can be saved in your profile. External location sharing and emergency messages are not configured in this build.
modal.verified_text: For safety, choose a public destination. A verified venue catalog and venue-type enforcement are not configured in this build.
